{"summary":"Customers report that delivery attempts fail because no one is home, leading to missed deliveries and frustration. [tk_132493]
They also complain that packages arrive damaged or with missing parts, requiring returns or exchanges. [tk_683856]
Customers also struggle to change delivery addresses or cancel orders, causing further frustration and issues. [tk_673251]
Overall, the spike reflects widespread dissatisfaction with delivery reliability, communication, and product condition. [tk_608119]"}
